# Daily Report — 2026-09-10

## Task Completed
Add `list_pa_targets` and `get_pa_target` tools for the `pa_target` table.

PA targets define desired, minimum, and maximum KPI values for a PA indicator
over a given time period.  `list_pa_targets` supports filtering by indicator
(name or sys_id auto-resolved), active state, and creation date range
(YYYY-MM-DD); results carry full pagination headers.  `get_pa_target` does a
direct sys_id lookup with 404 and empty-result guards.  Both tools are
registered in the `system_administrator` and `full` packages.
